meta.revisionPolicy: WDI revises history freely at every update: a new vintage can change any past value. Raw dumps keep every vintage.
meta.coverage: Population: totals, sex, and five-year age groups (WDI, from UN WPP)
meta.note: Values as published in WDI for India, unrounded. Each series is one WDI indicator; its code is the series name. Series start and end in different years; the axis spans the widest. WDI takes these from UN WPP 2024 and runs the estimates (to 2023) straight into the medium projection (2024 and 2025) in one series; the population-wpp bundles keep the two apart.
